unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U07: Track creation, modification, full satisfaction and inspection separately

facts.statement: Sections23-26 address prescribed filings, changes, full satisfaction within30days, borrower intimation/show cause up to14days, memorandum and inspection by any person on prescribed conditions.

payload.title: A repayment and a satisfied registry record are separate events
payload.core_explanation_md:
A change to the terms or extent of registered security requires its own modification record under section 24. Full payment or satisfaction also requires the stated intimation under section 25; the creditor or ARC must not treat a bank-ledger closure as proof that the register was updated. The source specifies thirty days from full payment or satisfaction.

If a borrower reports that satisfaction was not recorded, the statutory process calls for a creditor show-cause notice with a period not exceeding fourteen days. The Registrar then follows the no-cause or cause-shown route. Section26 permits inspection on the prescribed terms; inspecting a record does not itself modify or discharge it.

self_check.prompt_text: Does viewing an entry remove a charge?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Inspection, modification and satisfaction have distinct purposes.

payload.stem_md: A borrower has fully paid the secured obligation. The bank closes the loan ledger but has no satisfaction-filing evidence. What remains to be reconciled?

options.explanation_md: Valuation does not establish satisfaction filing.

options.text_md: A fresh creation entry for the repaid debt
options.explanation_md: Creating a new entry is not the satisfaction task.

options.text_md: Nothing because loan closure automatically edits every register
options.explanation_md: An internal closure is not proof of registry action.

options.text_md: The section 25 intimation and resulting registry satisfaction record
options.explanation_md: Payment and recording full satisfaction are distinct obligations.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Payment and recording full satisfaction are distinct obligations.

payload.stem_md: A person pays the prescribed inspection fee and views the registry particulars. Which effect follows solely from that inspection?

options.text_md: The person becomes the secured creditor
options.explanation_md: Viewing a record does not transfer creditor rights.

options.text_md: Access to the recorded particulars, without automatic alteration of the security
options.explanation_md: Inspection is an information function, not a discharge or assignment.

options.text_md: The security is satisfied because it has been searched
options.explanation_md: A search is not payment or satisfaction.
Inspection does not reverse registered transactions.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Inspection is an information function, not a discharge or assignment.
